scope: Exact comparison against the accepted frozen 24-package base payload only; no global duplicate search is claimed.
storage_decision: Committed predecessor owners are reused exactly where proven. This extension keeps its independently mapped gzip endpoints even when their bytes match the separately accepted base payload. The unchanged reader accepts only local extension endpoints or pinned committed Git owners; it does not invent a committed owner for the unmerged base payload. No whole base payload directory is copied.
